tasks.title: Implement ngv2/workers/hunt.py run_stage hunt-phase worker
acceptance_criteria: run_stage reads phase/target/prior_findings/parked_package from the context produced by session_get_task.get_task without mutating it.
run_stage calls the injected llm-client seam to surface candidate leads and applies the injected hunt-phase may_confirm gate to each candidate.
Only gate-confirmed candidates are returned; each returned dict is parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) and shaped for the contracts.Finding dataclass.
An empty / no-lead llm-client response yields an empty list (no crash).
No existing committed module (llm_client.py, contracts.py, gate modules, artifact_harvester.py, session_get_task.py, base_worker) is edited in place; seams are consumed only via injection.
build_default_seams, the conductor loop, gated_advance, the StageWorker base runner, and triage/verify/late-phase workers are NOT introduced here.

spec.objective: Provide the hunt-phase stage worker that composes the injected llm-client seam with the hunt-phase may_confirm gate to surface candidate findings as artifact dicts, leaving seam assembly and conductor orchestration to other modules.
functional_requirements: Expose run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict] in ngv2/workers/hunt.py.
Resolve task fields (phase, target, prior_findings, parked_package) from the context shape returned by session_get_task.get_task(session_row) without mutating context or seams.
Invoke the injected llm-client seam (per ngv2/llm_client.py signature) to obtain candidate hunt leads for the target.
Apply the injected hunt-phase may_confirm gate to each candidate and drop candidates the gate rejects.

Shape each confirmed candidate into an artifact dict that is parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) and whose payload aligns with the contracts.Finding dataclass fields.
Return an empty list when the llm-client seam yields no lead or all candidates are rejected, without raising.
edge_cases: llm-client seam returns an empty / no-lead response -> run_stage returns [].
Gate rejects a candidate -> that candidate is excluded from the result list.
Mixed batch: some candidates confirmed, some rejected -> only confirmed ones surface.
Malformed or partial candidate from the seam is skipped rather than crashing the stage.
non_goals: Do not build build_default_seams, the conductor loop, gated_advance, or the StageWorker base runner.
Do not build triage.py, verify.py, or any late-phase worker (poc.py, detonate.py, novelty.py, report.py).
Do not edit llm_client.py, contracts.py, the gate modules, artifact_harvester.py, session_get_task.py, or base_worker in place.
spec.implementation_notes:
Consume the llm-client, may_confirm gate, and write seams strictly via the injected seams argument so the worker stays testable with stubs. Treat parse_stage_artifact(filename, content, phase) as the shape contract for returned dicts and contracts.Finding as the payload contract. Keep the module pure of network/process side effects; StageWorker(task, get_task_fn, stage_fn, write_fn) from base_worker is the intended consumer of stage_fn=run_stage but is not constructed here.

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Stub llm-client returning (a) no lead, (b) one confirmable candidate, (c) a mixed batch; stub may_confirm gate that confirms/rejects deterministically; a sample context dict matching get_task output and a contracts.Finding-shaped reference payload.

token_budget_ratio.note: Worker logic is thin composition glue; test surface (stubs + shape assertions) is proportionally larger.

tasks.title: Author mutation-gated test sibling for ngv2/workers/hunt.py
acceptance_criteria: test_hunt.py is the test_authoring sibling whose mutation_target is ngv2.workers.hunt.
Tests are driven entirely by a stub llm-client and stub seams; no real network, model, or filesystem side effects.
Covers at least the edge case of an empty/no-lead llm-client response and the edge case of a gate that rejects a candidate.
Asserts confirmed candidates produce artifact dicts parseable by artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact and shaped for contracts.Finding.
The suite fails against the declared mutant of ngv2.workers.hunt (non-vacuous).

spec.objective: Provide a non-vacuous oracle for ngv2/workers/hunt.py run_stage, exercising the hunt-phase composition of the llm-client seam and may_confirm gate through stubs, including the empty-lead and gate-rejection edge cases required by the brief.
functional_requirements: Drive run_stage(context, seams) using a stub llm-client seam and stub gate/write seams with no real side effects.
Edge case: stub llm-client returns no lead -> assert run_stage returns an empty list.
Edge case: stub gate rejects a candidate -> assert the rejected candidate does not appear in the result.
Happy path: a confirmed candidate yields an artifact dict that parse_stage_artifact accepts and that maps onto contracts.Finding fields.
Provide a verification_command that names the authored oracle file and run cleanly under it.
spec.interfaces: pytest module ngv2/workers/test_hunt.py targeting run_stage(context, seams) -> list[dict]
edge_cases: Gate rejects one of several candidates.
Stub gate confirms all -> every candidate surfaces and parses.
non_goals: Do not test build_default_seams, the conductor loop, gated_advance, or the StageWorker base runner.
Do not modify ngv2/workers/hunt.py or any committed seam module from the test.
spec.implementation_notes: Build lightweight stub seams: a stub llm-client object/callable returning scripted candidate batches, and a stub may_confirm gate with deterministic confirm/reject behavior. Use a context dict matching session_get_task.get_task output. Assert via artifact_harvester.parse_stage_artifact and against contracts.Finding to lock the shape. Tests must kill the declared mutant of ngv2.workers.hunt.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Stub llm-client seam scripts: empty/no-lead, single confirmable candidate, mixed/rejected batches; stub may_confirm gate with deterministic confirm and reject branches; get_task-shaped context fixture; expected contracts.Finding-shaped artifact reference for shape assertions.

token_budget_ratio.note: Authoring task; the deliverable is the test oracle itself, so test tokens dominate the budget.
